description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Yardi is hiring a Software Development Engineer I for its Residential Military team. The role develops, enhances, tests, troubleshoots, and maintains software applications supporting military housing operations, while collaborating with cross-functional partners to deliver reliable solutions.
Software Development Engineer I designing, developing, testing, and maintaining military housing operations software; resolving defects and implementing enhancements.

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications that support military housing operations
• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects while ensuring application quality, reliability, and performance
• Perform unit testing and validation activities to support application accuracy, interoperability, and overall product quality
• Implement software enhancements and approved changes that improve functionality and user experience
• Develop foundational knowledge of software engineering practices, AI technologies, product features, and industry-specific business processes to deliver effective solutions

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
• Foundational programming skills in one or more modern languages or frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Java, or equivalent)
• Exposure to relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle)
• Working knowledge of software development tools such as source code editors, compilers, debuggers, and version control systems
• Basic understanding of software development concepts, including APIs, data structures, debugging, testing, and multi-layer application architecture (database, server, and client)
• Ability to effectively leverage at least one primary programming language to develop and maintain software solutions
• Basic understanding of AI concepts and the responsible use of AI-assisted development tools
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
• Attention to detail with a high level of accuracy
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Time management, task prioritization, and organizational skills
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment

Preferred:
• Exposure to web or mobile application development
• Internship, academic project, or equivalent hands-on experience in software development
• Exposure to building or consuming RESTful APIs
• Familiarity with Git or other version control systems
• Understanding of modern development practices, including CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks
• Exposure to cloud environments, containerized applications, or cloud-native development
• Interest in user-centered application design and development
• Exposure to AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted development tools, or machine learning concepts
